title: Raymond Burke and his strange instruments
summary: Zanco jammed with Raymond Burke outside his shop, and describes the homemade horns and clutter inside.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Well, that was before, Raymond played, I think while Joe was still here. Raymond, Raymond Burke played with the group. He hadn't played since I've been in the group, but I would like very much, you know, the opportunity to play with him, you know. I stopped over at Raymond's shop pretty regular and looked at some of these weird instruments he has in there. And I seen one evening I was passing, coming home from work, and he called me over and showed me this trumpet he had. With a lot of copper tubing on it and whatnot. So he played, he was playing a sort of thing, looked like a clarinet. And I was playing this trumpet. We were sitting right out there, right in front of his shop, right on the street. And we had a jam session, just the two of us sitting there, you know. And he's got some of the weirdest looking things there. He made a trombone, I think, with a lead pipe and funnels and this and that and the other. He's got a trombone.
That's got a tenor mouthpiece and a, for a bell it's got a plunger.
Two pieces of pipe. Yeah, I know that one. That's right, that's the thing. That's it. Paul's played that. He calls it a plunger phone or something. Yeah. I like to call it a plumber's nightmare.

Well, I don't know, I guess this thing that he's got with this trumpet with all the copper tubing, it looks more like a trumponet. You know, it looks like it might be part clarinet and part trumpet. You can't tell what it is.
Yeah. And then what's that thing that looks like a clarinet, it's got a cane reed or something on it. You've never seen it has a clarinet mouthpiece then he'd just have a piece of cane with it.
Yeah. With the holes. It's all bamboo flute. Mm-hmm. With a clarinet mouthpiece on it. It's ringing or something.

I stopped around there once and I wanted to get a tuba from him. I thought maybe he'd have an old tuba for sale, you know. But he didn't have anything that even resembled the tuba. He's got quite an interesting shop. You go in there, you could spend a day just looking. Of course you don't have far to go. You could spend a day trying to get in.
You spend a day trying to get in.
You spend a day trying to get in, that's right. But he's got a little bit of everything. There's only one Raymond.
